verdict.rationale: Raygun publishes a public v3 REST API with a downloadable OpenAPI 3.0.3 spec of 46 paths, a hosted Swagger UI with a working 'Try it out' runner, and an API guide; it is authenticated with Personal Access Tokens. This lets a user or agent programmatically access and manipulate Raygun data, and further API surfaces exist for deployments and source map uploads. The root-domain OpenAPI probe 404s only show the spec lives at the API origin, not that it is absent. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of driving the product end-to-end via the API, and a formal versioning/deprecation policy.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can drive the product through a documented public API

citations.quote: allows you to access your Raygun data so that you can display, manipulate and process it in other tools, scripts and applications.
This is version 3 of Raygun's API. While we transition, the RUM API will remain available
